dishes.name: Sandre au beurre blanc
dishes.desc: Loire pikeperch with beurre blanc, a sauce of shallots, white wine and butter. The sauce was born in the Nantes area and still goes on every Loire fish.

dishes.name: Gâteau nantais
dishes.desc: Almond cake made with salted butter and rum, brushed with a rum glaze. A travel cake from the port of Nantes, sold in bakeries.

dishes.name: Petit-beurre LU
dishes.desc: The square butter biscuit with 52 teeth, created in Nantes by the LU biscuit makers in 1886. Still the city's best-known sweet souvenir.

dishes.name: Berlingot nantais
dishes.desc: Pillow-shaped boiled sweet from Nantes, flavoured with mint, lemon or orange and filled with a core of liquid fruit.

dishes.name: Curé nantais
dishes.desc: Soft washed-rind cow's-milk cheese from the Nantes area with a strong smell and mild, buttery taste. Sold in orange squares at markets and cheese shops.

dishes.name: Mogettes de Vendée
dishes.desc: Slow-cooked white beans of the Vendée, eaten with a thick slice of ham or with butter and bread. A farm-table classic of the inland Vendée.
